why: The owner needs several rounds to get a visualization out of an agent that TuffUI ships at first sight, and asked for a self-improving loop that raises the skills, the kit and the reviewer until one try is enough. docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md is the protocol; it specialises docs/v3/CYCLES.md. This is the baseline: it measures what ships on master before anything is changed for it.
what: Cycle 1 of the expression area: six one-shot trials, scored against the rubric and the references, diagnosed, filed.
owns: docs/v3/expression/cases.md (the `ran` column, and two new cases)
docs/plan.yaml (append rows; add contract-amending fix rows to the `after` of v3-freeze-g4; nothing else)
apps/playground/src/** (the six trial scenarios only: new files plus registry entries)
change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases c01, c02, c03, c04, c06 and one native case: the first `n` row that v3-spike-viz-census appended to the bank (n01 if it appended none). You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier. Its prompt is the case row verbatim, the scenario registry path (apps/playground/src/scenarios/registry.tsx), the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and this fence: read only packages/basalt-ui/agent/**, packages/basalt-ui/llms.txt, the published subpaths' types and the playground's own code; never docs/v3/expression/**, docs/v3/evidence/ext-tuffui-devices.md, .claude/shots/**, docs/v3/cycles/** or any TuffUI source; import basalt-ui through published subpaths only; mark every workaround `// cycle-expression-1: <what the kit lacked>`; return the files written and a list of what it wanted from the kit or the skill and did not find. Run builders one after another or on disjoint files; each adds one registry entry. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts. (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case, never the builder. Its prompt is the case row, the shot paths, the scenario file paths, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md, and for a c case the reference shot from docs/v3/expression/references.md (re-take it from the URL there if the file is missing). Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand the builder its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. The agent layer is still 2.x-worded and rows v3-sk-5 to v3-sk-10 own that: class such findings `planned` and append them as a `note` to the owning row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md: confirmed, open or killed, one paragraph each, naming the number and the side it fell on. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts, or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Every `primitive` and `doctrine` fix row joins the `after` of v3-freeze-g4, and so does v3-cycle-expression-2 if such a P1 is open (EXPRESSION.md § Gate). Add two new cases to the bank from sources not used yet. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row.
commits: Scenarios in one feat: commit, findings, bank and plan rows in a docs: commit. No package commit.
proof: docs/v3/cycles/expression-1.md with the sha, the numbers table from EXPRESSION.md, per case the round scores, verdict and shot paths, the findings table, and the three hypothesis verdicts.
acceptance: docs/v3/cycles/expression-1.md exists, names the master sha and the six cases, and has every number from EXPRESSION.md § Numbers every cycle reports
Each of the six cases has round-0 item scores with citations from a reviewer subagent that did not build it, and each c case has a verdict
Every point lost in round 0 is a finding with a class, a severity and evidence
Each of the three hypotheses is ruled confirmed, open or killed against the thresholds, with the numbers that say so
Every P1 has its own plan row with a brief; the P2s are grouped one row per class; `planned` findings are notes on their owning rows

Every row that adds an export, amends charts/contract.ts or changes primitive-bypass has `checkpoint: spec`; every `primitive` and `doctrine` fix row is in the `after` of v3-freeze-g4, and so is the next cycle while such a P1 is open
A v3-cycle-expression-2 row exists after every fix row, with six cases that have not run, or the file states convergence
cases.md marks the six cases `ran: 1` and holds two new cases
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD lists nothing under packages/basalt-ui/ and `factory plan check` passes
out_of_scope: Fixing any finding in this PR; hand-editing a builder's scenario; changing the rubric; shipping a new chart kind; copying TuffUI source anywhere.
